conventions.senate_total: 100 minus Republican seats; includes a possible Nebraska independent on the non-Republican side
conventions.primary_axis: 0 is the strongest Democratic joint chamber performance; 100 is the strongest Republican performance
conventions.chamber_tilt_axis: 0 is Senate overperformance; 100 is House overperformance
conventions.geography_axis: low emphasizes IA/MI/OH/TX; high emphasizes AK/ME
conventions.zero_count: Not observed in 10,000 draws; not proof of zero probability

six_state_geography.derivation: First principal component of the six continuous Democratic race margins after projecting out the equal-weight/common direction

house_senate.derivation: Standardize chamber seat totals, then rotate 45 degrees: overall=(House z + Senate z)/sqrt(2); tilt=(House z - Senate z)/sqrt(2)

route_rarity.derivation: -ln P(six-state combination | Democratic-aligned Senate total), with a probability-weighted conditional midrank percentile
